skill.displayName: Generate Managed IT Services Provider Client Education Handout
skill.summary: Create a polished client handout with visuals, FAQs, and next steps to educate clients about managed IT services provided by your MSP.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Generate Managed IT Services Provider Client Education Handout skill.

- Creates comprehensive client education handouts for managed IT service providers, including visuals, FAQs, and actionable next steps.
- Designed for use by MSP founders and technical account teams to enhance client communication and education.
- Utilizes chat and image generation APIs to deliver polished, informative assets.
- Optimized for SEO with targeted keywords and search intent focused on client education.
